mfg1-electrical-l071.sourceJa: 外部電圧のないpn接合。空乏層のp側には負、n側には正の固定イオンがあり、内部電界はn側からp側へ向かう。外側の正孔・電子は移動キャリアで、領域全体の帯電を示さない。
mfg1-electrical-l071.text: A pn junction without external voltage. Fixed ions are negative on the p side and positive on the n side of the depletion region; the internal electric field points from n to p. Holes and electrons outside are mobile carriers and do not indicate net charge of the entire regions.

mfg1-electrical-l077.sourceJa: 入力が1秒でオン、6秒でオフになる紙上例。3秒のオンディレーは4秒でオン、6秒でオフ。3秒のオフディレーは1秒でオン、9秒でオフ。設定や配線の手順ではない。
mfg1-electrical-l077.text: A paper example with input on at 1 second and off at 6 seconds. A 3-second on-delay turns on at 4 seconds and off at 6 seconds. A 3-second off-delay turns on at 1 second and off at 9 seconds. This is not a setting or wiring procedure.

mfg1-electrical-l087.sourceJa: 電気用図記号22項目。接点の常態、動作方式、半導体の端子と矢印を名称と対応させる。PNPの矢印はエミッタ側で内向き。実機の配線図や端子配列ではない。
mfg1-electrical-l087.text: 22 electrical symbols. Match normal contact states, operating methods, semiconductor terminals and arrows to their names. The PNP arrow is on the emitter and points inward. This is not an actual wiring diagram or terminal layout.
